25.original: Use the spyglass to count the number of pixies.

48.original: Oh, to have so many mortals visiting us... I can scarcely contain my excitement!

49.original: I know a really fun game! Come with me, and we'll have oodles of fun together!

50.original: There you are! Here, I will lend you this tube.

51.original: A spyglass, I believe you mortals call it, and it makes small things look big. We're going to use it for our game.

52.original: The rules are simple: stand over there, look through the spyglass, and count the pixies. If you get our number right, I'll give you a fabulous prize!

53.original: Inspect the designated location to look through the spyglass and begin counting pixies.

54.original: You will have thirty seconds to complete the task, after which you may give your answer to the chipper pixie.

55.original: Stand over there, look through the spyglass, and count the pixies. There's nothing to it!

56.original: Done counting, are you? So, how many of us are there?

61.original: Are you sure? Really, truly, <hex:021A020203>absolutely<hex:021A020103> sure? Because if you aren't, you should check again!

62.original: Correct, there are four of us! Well done, mortal! Here's the fabulous prize I─<hex:02100103>...Oh, fiddlesticks, I left it back at Lydha Lran!

63.original: Well, we'll just have to make a game of it. Last one back to the village is a rotten egg!

64.original: Tee hee, beat you back! I get to turn you into a rotten egg!

65.original: ...Oh, I jest, I jest! I won't turn you into a rotten egg─not so soon after you played with me, at any rate. Here's your prize. Let's play again soon!
